title: When the Blue Hour Wakes
author: Vesper Reyes
blurb: Coral Eastwick, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
